title: Psyduck
tagline: Revolutionizing donation culture on live streaming platforms. Empower streamers to launch ERC-1155 NFTs, enabling viewers to support content creators directly through Web3 wallets.
description: Psyduck is a decentralized application for live streaming donations that not only integrates the web3 and web2 worlds, but also provides more donation types for live streaming viewers. It innovates the interaction between live streamer and viewers. Psyduck provides a website and Chrome extension for live streamer to create NFTs and donate the tip. Viewers can donate our cryptocurrency Psycoin or purchase live streamer's NFTs to support their favorite live streamer.
how_its_made:
We are witnessing a revolutionary tipping application on a live streaming platform, utilizing decentralized applications (DApps) and non-fungible token (NFT) technology on the Base chain. This application enhances interaction between viewers and live streamer, while elevating Web3 applications to new heights in real-life integration.

Our solution has the following features and advantages:
Use opBNB to store token donation metadata
Use Chrome Extension to build web connect plugin that interacts with Ethereum blockchain
Use Solidity to create smart contract
Use React.js to build frontend
Use Cloudflare_serverless to build serverless
